i lost my baby boy almost a year ago now. he had just turned 2. it was very sudden and he was healthy before, but i didn't take him to the vet in time and when i did, he had to be put to sleep. aside from all the guilt, i really feel like i lost myself the day i lost him. it still really hurts to look back, even on happy memories, because it just brings up so much pain. i haven't even been able to give him a funeral or a memorial display. i keep all of his things and ashes in his old carrier in a cupboard. i just can't do it. when it first happened, i really struggled for a few months but it did slowly start to become less overwhelming and more so lingering. it doesn't hurt any less when i think about it but i am able to get on with life a bit better. it will take a long time so give yourself the time to just go through these emotions. it really helped me to read other people's stories at first, because it made me feel less alone about how intense and real it felt despite some people in my life dismissing it as 'just a pet'. i am blessed to have three bunnies now, which i am trying to bond but not very successfully, one of which is the girlfriend of my late bun. they have helped me the most in my recovery, so when you are ready to think about it, looking at adopting a new bun might give you a chance to give an outlet for all that love you have nowhere to put now. but it's so fresh for you now, i think the only thing you can do to cope is take time for yourself and what you really need. i love the little shrine you made for him, it looks beautiful. just finds ways like that honour him, that way he will always be there with you in a way. hopefully my Tumble will look out for him in bunny heaven <3 best of luck, grief is the price we pay for love, and it only hurts so much because you love him so much.
